tier_rule: quantile: 非硬排除者按 score 分位分带 tier1>=P60 / tier2>=P30（区域内自适应）；硬地板 cov<0.65 或 usableFields<10 → excluded；mode=general（alphaCount 仅 score 软罚）；crowd_veto: alphaCount>1000 一票否决；保底带（O2/O4/O6，tier_note 溯源）：backfill_band(0.65<=cov<0.85 & alphaCount<=50 & valueScore>=6)→tier2[生成须 ts_backfill(66/120)]；probe_exception(cov>=0.9 & alphaCount==0 & valueScore>=6 & 字段<硬地板)→tier2[仅限 Stage A 探针早停]; crowd_band(alphaCount>100 & <=alpha_count_max & cov>=0.7 & valueScore>=4)→tier2[cov<0.85 生成须 ts_backfill]
